product_metadata.title: Lavender Scented Candles, Friendship Gifts with Funny Saying, Gifts for Best Friend, Humorous Scented Jar Candle Gifts for BFF Bestie, Gifts for Birthday Christmas Thanksgiving
features: Funny Gifts for Friends: With funny saying "friends come and go, like waves of the ocean, but the true ones stick, like a f**king octopus on your face" on the front of the jar, this scented candle will be a ideal gift for your best friend.

100% Natural Soy Candles: Made with 100% all natural soy wax and 100% cotton wick, our scented candles burn without any contamination and have a pleasant relaxing lavender scent. These organic soy candles fills the air with a natural beauty and a natural scent. Clean to purify the air in your home/room for at least 50 hours.

Pleasant & Relaxing Smell: Added pure plant essential oils in precise proportions, our candles smell great but not overpowering, which is excellent to create a peaceful, soothing, and elegant ambiance that will help people relax and feel happy. This aromatherapy candle was produced for purification, stress relief, anxiety soothing and positive energy providing.

Long Lasting Burning Time: Pure soy wax is known for providing a long lasting burning. 7 oz soy candles has an approximate burn time of 50 hours. This blend organic candles that will surely relief your stress and will uplift your mood.

Suitable for Many Occasions: Carefully packaged in a lovely gift box, this scented jar candle is the great choice as a gift. You can give this scented candle gift set to your friends in any festival, such as birthday, Christmas, Thanksgiving, etc.
